title: Independent proposals
summary: Separate agents explore genuinely different approaches to one decision.
useWhen: An ambiguous plan benefits from independent alternatives.
No single decisive source settles the choice.
avoidWhen: A simple test resolves the uncertainty.
contract: Do not supply sibling outputs to drafters.
Choose select, fuse or a narrow compact-answer vote as the terminal.
example: Compare two API designs against requirements fixed before drafting.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  Q[Common requirements] --> A[Approach A]
  Q --> B[Approach B]
  A --> J[Select / fuse / vote]
  B --> J
  J --> V[Fresh acceptance]
